notes.title: Leave us a positive evaluation!
notes.content:
You have tried "A steak temple panic" and it made you laugh?

Leave us a positive review! It will help us to be better referenced in the store!

Thanks a lot !

notes.title: RELEASE OF THE SECOND CHAPTER IN DLC!
notes.content:
It is with great excitement that we announce the release of the first chapter of "A Steak Temple Panic"!

This is our second game as an independent developer, and we put all our heart into it!

[b]Don't forget to leave us a positive review![/b]

It will help us a lot to get known!

A huge thanks for your support!

notes.title: D-1 to the release of the second chapter of A Steak Temple Panic !!!
notes.content:
D-1 to the release of the second chapter of "A Steak Temple Panic"!!!

The T-House:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/a9bccbbdcc7cbf87194da07a1f4dfdf8c97acc49.png[/img]
The T-House is located on the Russian Mountain...
Yes, on a mountain, which is Russian...

And no, next to it is not a Russian Mountain it is a roller coaster...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/5f21947eefd227947263e91f0f914a1382e17ca9.png[/img]
Some people also call it a Russian Mountain..

It's clear, right?

No?

notes.title: D-3 before the release of the second chapter of "A Steak Temple Panic" !
notes.content:
D-3 before the release of the second chapter of "A Steak Temple Panic" !

In Sanglinours is one of the biggest rollercoaster of the region...
It's normal, it's also the only amusement park in the area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/5f21947eefd227947263e91f0f914a1382e17ca9.png[/img]


Don't confuse the rollercoaster with the Russian Mountain... The Russian Mountain is next door.......

notes.title: D-5 before the release of the second chapter of "A steak Temple Panic"!
notes.content:
[u][b]Sanglinours[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/61b628e55cde2a51194fb1e456d333c3bff3b8de.png[/img]

Its attractions are very original...

We will reveal you one of them in a few days...

notes.title: The DLC containing the second chapter of the adventure arrives on October 25th!
notes.content:
Did the first chapter of "Panic at Temple A-Steak" make you laugh out loud?

Good news! [b]The DLC containing the second chapter of the adventure arrives on October 25th! (And it's even funnier!)
[/b]
Ready to go in quest of the Xiuhcoatl?

notes.title: Chapiter 1 stream by LudumInvaders
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/f39a2b939b1638f01032b443914c1ad85bbb7c1b.png[/img]

Gilles and Gaël from Ludum Invaders have prepared a let's play video of chapter 1!

Thanks again to both of them for this great let's play!

notes.title: Only a few days left before the first FREE chapter release !
notes.content:
In this cooperative narrative game, you have the choice to interpret your character as you wish!

For that, you will have the opportunity, during the main dialogues, to choose between four emotions:
- [b]anger[/b]
-[b] sadness[/b]
- [b]joy[/b]
-[b] remain neutral[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/15a28f171648a153cec0c8ee64dfcf9bbd9cc9bb.png[/img]

[b]These choices have no impact on the story, but rather on the way you interpret your character![/b]

Try different combinations, they are always very funny!

notes.title: Only one week left before the release of the first FREE chapter!
notes.content:
How to play "A Steak Temple Panic" ?

"A Steak Temple Panic" is a cooperative adventure for [b]two players![/b]

The player who plays as Bob plays with the[b] keyboard[/b] only.

He uses the WASD keys and the arrow keys 
Yes, he plays with [b]BOTH HANDS ON THE KEYBOARD[/b]!!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/fb650fde81302aa33ed403b977e7da5c83311c42.png[/img]

The player who plays Jenn plays with the [b]mouse [/b]only! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/87238224fa2d187ed39b697fba2b9bdf441d1dbe.png[/img]

No it's ok with only one hand...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/7746be11feec7ac83f4f9f97a418aeff51362b88.png[/img]

Attention, [b]EVEN THE WHEEL IS USED![/b]

notes.title: First FREE chapter RELEASE !
notes.content:
[b]STOP WHATEVER YOU'RE DOING !!!![/b]

It's official, today is the release of the first "A Steak Temple Panic" FREE chapter !

Instructions for a night full of laughter:

1 - Call a friend

2 - Take a bag of crisps and fizzy drinks (healthier stuff is also allowed).

3 - Try out this crazy cooperative adventure that made all the playtesters howl with laughter !!!!!!!

notes.title: New trailer ! And new screenshots ! Release date announcement !
notes.content:
New trailer ! And new screenshots!

Check out the two-player co-op game that made playtesters howling with laughter!

The first FREE chapter of "A Steak Temple Panic" will be released on October 4th! 

The second chapter, as DLC, will arrive on October 27th for €1.99!

That's not even the price of your steak sauce!

notes.title: Stream/Devlog in French - Narrative cooperative game !
notes.content:
We're proud to show you our game, a funny narrative cooperative game !
We will mainly speak french during the stream, but we can answer your questions in english !

"Two secret agents must learn to work together on the most dangerous mission of their careers: recovering a magical Aztec artifact hidden in a theme park owned by a multi-billionaire who has the world in a tizzy because of his terrifying reputation."

[b]Platform[/b] : PC Windows Number of players : 2  (local only)

[b]Controller[/b] :

Player 1 (regular): keyboard only

Player 2 (casual): mouse only

[b]Compatible with Steam Remote Play!!!![/b]

[b]Language : French voices / French or English subtitles[/b]
